cases.user: Which open source conferences in Europe are coming up in 2027? I am especially interested in FOSDEM 2027.

cases.user: Welche Open-Source-Konferenzen in Europa gibt es 2027? Mich interessiert vor allem die FOSDEM 2027.

cases.user: I mostly write Python 3.12 backend services with FastAPI. How do I run several async database calls in parallel without exhausting the pool?
cases.assistant: Use asyncio.gather with a semaphore sized below your pool limit, or asyncio.TaskGroup in Python 3.12 so a failure cancels siblings. Keep the pool size and the semaphore in one config value.
